name: What kind of preparation do I need to do before drywall work begins?

mainEntity.name: What kind of preparation do I need to do before drywall work begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before drywall work begins, you should clear the work area of furniture, personal belongings, and valuables to prevent damage and allow contractors unobstructed access. Covering large, immovable items with plastic sheeting is recommended. If it's a new installation, ensure the framing is complete and inspected. For repairs, identify any underlying issues, such as leaks, that caused the damage, and have them fixed beforehand. This preparation helps ensure a smooth, efficient process and protects your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before drywall work, clear furniture and valuables, cover large items, and ensure any underlying issues like leaks are resolved. This preps the area for efficiency.
